# proxmox_node_stopall (Resource)

Stops all guests of a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/stopall` and waits for the worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_stopall" "all" {
  node       = "pve-1"
  force_stop = true
  triggers   = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to stop again.

### Optional

- `force_stop` (Boolean) Force stop instead of a clean shutdown.
- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum concurrent tasks.
- `timeout` (Number) Shutdown timeout in seconds.
- `vms` (Set of Number) Only stop these VMIDs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
